findings.explanation: On INV-1014 alone the stated figures do not reconcile: a total of 246000.00 INR with 36000.00 INR tax implies a subtotal of 210000.00, but 18% GST on 210000.00 would be 37800.00 (equivalently, 18% on a 200000.00 subtotal yields a 236000.00 total), so the stated subtotal, rate, and total are arithmetically inconsistent.
